request.description: POST register a new user. Body: name (REQUIRED, string, max 100), username (REQUIRED, string, max 100, unique), email (REQUIRED, email, unique), password (REQUIRED, string, confirmed, strong password rules), password_confirmation (REQUIRED, must match password).
POST login. Body: login (REQUIRED, string — email or username), password (REQUIRED, string, min 6), remember (optional, boolean), device_name (optional, string, max 50).
POST verify email. Body: email (REQUIRED, email, must exist in users), code (REQUIRED, string, size 6).
POST resend the email verification code. Body: email (REQUIRED, email).
POST request a password reset code. Body: email (REQUIRED, email, must exist in users).

POST reset password. Body: email (REQUIRED, email, must exist in users), code (REQUIRED, string, size 6), password (REQUIRED, string, confirmed), password_confirmation (REQUIRED, must match password).
POST logout the current device — no body.
GET the current authenticated user — no body.

DELETE the current authenticated user's account (soft-delete). Body: password (REQUIRED, string, must match current password). Blocks if user owns any projects. Per-role cleanup: manager (groups, tasks), user (tasks), observer (just leave). Personal data cleaned, profile reset, user soft-deleted.
GET the email verification status of the current user — no body.
POST logout from all devices — no body.
GET list of the current user's authenticated devices — no body.
DELETE a device identified by {tokenId} — no body.
POST logout all other devices (keeping the current one) — no body.
GET the current user's own profile — no body.
GET a profile identified by {profile} — no body.

PUT update profile identified by {profile}. All fields optional: phone (string, max 20, unique), bio (string, max 1000), job_title (string, max 255), skills (optional, array of {name (string, max 100, required with skills), rating (optional, integer, 1-10)}), avatar (url, max 255), location (string, max 255), alternative_email (email, max 255), social urls (twitter_url, facebook_url, instagram_url, youtube_url, github_url, portfolio_url, linkedin_url — url, max 255; cv_url — max 255, no url rule), language [ar,en], theme [light,dark], is_public (boolean), allow_messages (boolean), allow_invitation_requests (boolean). NO name field.

PATCH update profile identified by {profile}. All fields optional: phone (string, max 20, unique), bio (string, max 1000), job_title (string, max 255), skills (optional, array of {name (string, max 100, required with skills), rating (optional, integer, 1-10)}), avatar (url, max 255), location (string, max 255), alternative_email (email, max 255), social urls (twitter_url, facebook_url, instagram_url, youtube_url, github_url, portfolio_url, linkedin_url — url, max 255; cv_url — max 255, no url rule), language [ar,en], theme [light,dark], is_public (boolean), allow_messages (boolean), allow_invitation_requests (boolean). NO name field.
GET the skills of profile {profile} — no body.
POST add a skill to profile {profile}. Body: skill (REQUIRED, string, max 100), rating (optional, integer, 1-10, default 5).
PUT update the rating of a skill identified by {skill} in profile {profile}. Body: rating (REQUIRED, integer, 1-10).
DELETE a skill identified by {skill} from profile {profile} — no body.
POST block a user identified by {userId} — no body.
DELETE unblock a user identified by {userId} — no body.
GET the list of users blocked by the current user — no body.
GET whether the current user can message the owner of profile {profile} — no body.
GET whether the current user can invite the owner of profile {profile} — no body.

POST invite user to a project. Body: project_id (REQUIRED, must exist in projects — required in the BODY even though {profile} is in the URL), role (optional) [user,observer], message (optional, nullable, string, max 500).
GET my pending tasks — no body. Optional query params: sort_by [due_date,created_at,priority,title], sort_direction [asc,desc].
GET list of reminders — no body.

POST create reminder. Body: title (REQUIRED, string, max 255), message (optional, nullable, string, max 1000), remind_at (REQUIRED, date, must be after now), task_ids (optional, nullable, array of existing task ids).
PUT update reminder. All fields optional: title (string, max 255), message (nullable, string, max 1000), remind_at (date, must be after now), task_ids (nullable, array of existing task ids).
DELETE a reminder identified by {reminder} — no body.
POST snooze a reminder identified by {reminder}. Body: new_remind_at (REQUIRED, date, must be after now).
POST dismiss a reminder identified by {reminder} — no body.
GET reminders for a project identified by {project} — no body.

POST toggle project reaction. Body: reaction_type (REQUIRED, string) [like,love,dislike]. KNOWN BUG: the backend enum rule contains a trailing space (in:like,love,dislike ), so 'dislike' currently fails validation server-side.
GET project reactions — no body.
GET list of my invitations — no body.
PUT accept invitation. No body required — the action is determined by the endpoint (/accept).
PUT reject invitation. No body required — the action is determined by the endpoint (/reject).
POST send invitation. Body: invitee_id (REQUIRED, must exist in users), message (optional, nullable, string, max 500), role (optional) [user,observer].
POST send join request. Body: message (optional, nullable, string, max 500).
GET list of join requests — no body. Optional query params: per_page.
POST approve join request. Body: role (OPTIONAL) [user,manager,observer]. The status is determined by the endpoint; do NOT send a status field.
POST reject join request. The status is determined by the endpoint; no body is required.
GET project comments — no body.
POST create project comment. Body: content (REQUIRED, string, 1-5000 chars), parent_id (optional, nullable, must exist in project_comments).
GET single project comment — no body.
PUT update project comment. Body: content (REQUIRED, string, 1-5000 chars).
DELETE project comment — no body.

POST create project report. Body: reported_project_id (REQUIRED, must exist in projects, must NOT be your own project), reason (REQUIRED, string, max 255), details (optional, nullable, string, max 1000).
GET my note — no body.

PUT write my note. All fields optional: title (string, max 255), content (nullable, string), color (nullable, string, max 7, hex like #RRGGBB). FLAG: backend NoteController type-hints a non-existent top-level StoreNoteRequest (latent bug in app/Http/Controllers/api/NoteController.php) — note validation is unreliable server-side.
DELETE (clear) my note — no body.

GET list of my projects — no body. Optional query params: search, role [owner,manager,user,observer], status [active,paused,completed], visibility [private,public], sort_by [created_at,name,updated_at,status], sort_direction [asc,desc].
GET my active owned projects — no body.

POST create project. Body: name (REQUIRED, string, max 255), description (optional, nullable, max 5000), image (optional, nullable, string, url, max 255), status (optional) [active,paused,completed], visibility (optional) [private,public], start_date (optional, date), end_date (optional, date, after or equal start_date), allow_commit (optional, boolean), allow_reactions (optional, boolean), chain_id (optional, must exist in chains). Note: the controller also reads allow_join_requests (not in the request rules).
GET single project — no body.

PUT update project. All fields optional (sometimes): name (string, max 255), description (optional, nullable, max 5000), image (optional, nullable, url, max 255), visibility (optional) [private,public], allow_join_requests (optional, boolean), status (optional) [active,paused,completed], allow_commit (optional, boolean), allow_reactions (optional, boolean).
DELETE project (soft delete / move to trash) — no body.
PATCH update project status. Body: status (REQUIRED) [active,paused,completed].
PATCH update project visibility. Body: visibility (REQUIRED) [private,public].
POST restore project from trash — no body.
GET trashed projects — no body.
DELETE project permanently (force delete) — no body.
DELETE permanently empty the projects trash — no body.
GET project stats — no body.
GET project users — no body.
POST add user to project. Body: user_id (REQUIRED, must exist in users), role (REQUIRED) [manager,member,observer].
POST leave project — no body.
PUT update user role. Body: role (REQUIRED) [manager,member,observer].
DELETE remove user from project — no body. The user to remove is identified by {userId} in the URL.
POST transfer project ownership — no body. The new owner is identified by {userId} in the URL.
GET all assigned tasks (assigned to any project user) grouped by status for Kanban view — no body. Returns data: [{ status: {id, name, position}, tasks: [...], tasks_count }], total_tasks.

POST create task (assignable variant). Body: title (required, string, max 255), description (optional, nullable, max 5000), priority (optional) [low,medium,high,urgent], due_date (optional, date >= today), status_id (optional, must exist in task_statuses), allow_subtasks (optional, boolean, default false), assigned_to (optional, integer, must exist in users) — single assignee.

POST create task (parent variant — allows subtasks). Body: title (required, string, max 255), description (optional, nullable, max 5000), priority (optional) [low,medium,high,urgent], due_date (optional, date >= today), status_id (optional, must exist in task_statuses), allow_subtasks (true — enables subtasks). assigned_to is PROHIBITED when allow_subtasks is true.

body.raw:
{
    "title": "Parent Task",
    "description": "Parent task that allows subtasks",
    "priority": "high",
    "due_date": "2026-08-25",
    "status_id": 1,
    "allow_subtasks": true
}

request.description: GET single task — no body.

PUT update task. All fields optional: title, description (optional), priority (optional) [low,medium,high,urgent], due_date (optional, date >= today), status_id (optional, must exist in task_statuses — validated but IGNORED by the controller), assigned_to (optional, integer, must exist in users) — single assignee, position (optional, integer >= 0 — validated but REJECTED with 422 when changing status; use reorder-tasks instead).
PUT update task status. Body: status_id (required, must exist in task_statuses), position (optional, integer >= 0).
DELETE task (soft delete / move to trash) — no body.
POST reorder tasks. Body MUST BE: {"tasks":[{"id":1,"position":0,"status_id":1}]} — all three sub-fields required.

POST create subtask under any parent task. The subtask inherits assigned_group_id from the parent automatically (not provided by user). Body: title (REQUIRED, string, max 255), description (optional, nullable, string, max 5000), priority (optional) [low,medium,high,urgent], due_date (optional, date, after_or_equal:today), assigned_to (REQUIRED, integer, must exist in users) — if parent has a group, assignee must be a member of that group.
GET trashed tasks — no body.
POST restore task from trash — no body.
DELETE task permanently — no body.
DELETE permanently empty the tasks trash — no body.
GET completed tasks — no body.
GET tasks assigned to the current user — no body.
GET unassigned tasks — no body.

POST create group task. Body: assigned_group_id (REQUIRED, must exist in groups), title (required), description (optional), priority (optional) [low,medium,high,urgent], due_date (optional), status_id (optional, must exist in task_statuses).
GET group tasks — no body. Optional query params: search, status_id, priority, sort_by, sort_direction.
GET archived tasks — no body. Optional query params: search, sort_by, sort_direction.
GET task history — no body.
GET the transfer history of a task — no body.
POST transfer a task to another project. Body: target_project_id (REQUIRED, must exist in projects), note (optional, nullable, string, max 500). Only the project owner can transfer tasks.
GET my kanban tasks (all tasks where the current user is assigned) — no body.
GET task assignments — no body.
POST assign users to task. Body: user_ids (REQUIRED, array min 1 of existing user ids).
DELETE unassign user from task — no body.
GET my assigned tasks — no body.
GET task dependencies — no body.
POST add task dependency. Body: depends_on_task_id (REQUIRED, must exist in tasks), type (optional) [FS,SS,FF,SF], default FS.
DELETE task dependency — no body.

PUT update dependency type. Body MUST include depends_on_task_id (required, must exist in tasks — required by the request class even though it is also in the URL) plus type (optional) [FS,SS,FF,SF], default FS.
GET task statuses — no body.
POST create task status. Body: name (REQUIRED, string, 2-100 chars). No other fields.
POST create default statuses (To Do / In Progress / Done) — no body.
POST reorder task statuses. Body MUST BE: {"statuses":[{"id":1,"position":0}]} — both sub-fields required, NO status_id sub-field.
PUT update task status. Body: name (REQUIRED, string, 2-100 chars). No other fields.
DELETE task status — no body.
POST send a test notification (not available in production). Body: message (REQUIRED, string), type (optional) [info,success,warning,error,urgent], default info.
GET list of the caller's notifications — no body.
PUT mark a notification identified by {notification} as read — no body.
PUT mark all of the caller's notifications as read — no body.
DELETE a notification identified by {notification} — no body.
POST register an FCM device token. Body: token (REQUIRED, string, max 500), device_type (optional) [android,ios,web], max 50, device_name (optional, string, max 255).
POST unregister an FCM device token. Body: token (REQUIRED, string, max 500).
GET list of the caller's registered FCM devices — no body.
POST create a report against a user. Body: reported_user_id (REQUIRED, must exist in users, cannot report self), reason (REQUIRED, string, max 255), details (optional, nullable, string, max 1000).

GET search users and projects — query params only, no body. Query params: q (REQUIRED, string, min 2, max 100), limit (optional — accepts 'all' and '0' too), job_title (optional, string, max 100), location (optional, string, max 100), created_from (optional, date Y-m-d), created_to (optional, date Y-m-d), is_public_profile (optional, boolean), skills (optional, string, max 200), visibility (optional) [private,public], status (optional) [active,paused,completed], start_date_from (optional, date Y-m-d), start_date_to (optional, date Y-m-d), end_date_from (optional, date Y-m-d), end_date_to (optional, date Y-m-d), created_by (optional, integer, min 1).
GET list of the caller's favorite users — no body.
POST add a user to favorites. Body: user_id (REQUIRED, must exist in users, cannot add self).
DELETE a favorite user identified by {userId} — no body.
POST toggle a user in favorites identified by {userId} — no body.
GET check if a user identified by {userId} is in the caller's favorites — no body.
GET list of the caller's favorite projects — no body.
POST add a project to favorites. Body: project_id (REQUIRED, must exist in projects).
DELETE a favorite project identified by {projectId} — no body.
POST toggle a project in favorites identified by {projectId} — no body.
GET check if a project identified by {projectId} is in the caller's favorites — no body.
GET list of groups for a project — no body.
GET single group — no body.
GET group members — no body.
POST leave group — no body.

POST create group. Body: name (REQUIRED, string, 2-255 chars), manager_id (REQUIRED, must exist in users), member_ids (REQUIRED, array min 1 of existing user ids, all different from manager_id), description (optional, nullable, max 1000), avatar (optional, nullable, url, max 255). Use integers (not strings) for manager_id and member_ids.
PUT update group. All fields optional (sometimes): name (string, 2-255 chars), description (optional, nullable, max 1000), avatar (optional, nullable, url, max 255), is_active (optional, boolean).
DELETE group — no body.
POST add member to group. Body: user_id (REQUIRED, must exist in users).
DELETE remove member from group — no body.
POST transfer group manager. Body: new_manager_id (REQUIRED, must exist in users).
GET the manager of a group — no body.
POST set/change the group manager. Body: user_id (REQUIRED, must exist in users, must be a member of the group first, cannot be the project owner).
GET all groups where the current user is the manager — no body.
GET all groups where the current user is a member — no body.
POST expel all members from a group (owner-only). Removes all members from the group and sets manager_id to null — no body.
POST detach all tasks from a group (owner-only). Sets assigned_group_id to null — no body.
GET tasks related to a group that have no status (not yet on the kanban board) — no body.
GET all tasks related to a group grouped by status for Kanban view — no body.
GET all completed group tasks for a specific group (tasks where assigned_group_id matches the group and completed_at is not null). Returns tasks ordered by completed_at desc.
GET all archived group tasks for a specific group (tasks where assigned_group_id matches the group and is_archived is true). Returns tasks ordered by updated_at desc.
GET group tasks that are assigned to at least one member of the group (tasks where assigned_group_id matches the group and assigned_to is a group member). Returns tasks ordered by created_at desc.

GET group tasks that are NOT assigned to any member of the group (tasks where assigned_group_id matches the group but assigned_to is null or not a group member). Returns tasks ordered by created_at desc.

POST transfer group manager role to the user identified by {userId} in the URL. Alternative to the body-based transfer-manager endpoint. The new manager must be a current member of the group and not the project owner.
POST add a project to a chain identified by {chain}. Body: project_id (REQUIRED, must exist in projects), position (optional, integer, min 0).
DELETE remove a project identified by {project} from a chain identified by {chain} — no body.
POST reorder the projects in a chain identified by {chain}. Body: project_ids (REQUIRED, array of integers, each must exist in projects).
PUT update the name of a chain identified by {chain}. Body: name (REQUIRED, string, max 255).
POST transfer chain ownership — no body. The new owner id comes from the URL path {userId}; do NOT send it in the body.
